messages.subject: Meridian - Heads of Terms (subject to contract)
messages.plaintextBody:
Helena,

Attached are the Heads of Terms reflecting what's been agreed: £14.75m, 5% deposit, TOGC treatment, the Unit 6 rent deposit assigned to you, and a 30% residential overage for five years. Note these are subject to contract save for the exclusivity, confidentiality and governing law clauses.

Castle & Vane have the seller's signature in hand. Could you arrange signature on your side? I suggest Helena signs as Investment Director.

James

--
James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0820
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
